name: Kai
source:
A mysterious freak-quency player who often gives Sonnya the cold shoulder. Despite his cold and blunt nature he actually cares for Sonnya; he rarely shows it though. He has an obsession with sweets and turns out to be one of Sonnya's schoolmates.

[Edited from [url=http://lemmasoft.renai.us/forums/viewtopic.php?f=11&t=29640]Lemma Soft Thread[/url]]
